commandLine:
source $HOME/.bash_profile;
if [ $UseBusinessDate == 0 ]; then
  AC_REPDIR=/opt/mhi-ac/gateway/dev2/murex/out ac_extract.sh -c Pub_MURX_FGFX_1900 -i
else
  AC_REPDIR=/opt/mhi-ac/gateway/dev2/murex/out ac_extract.sh -d $BusinessDate -c Pub_MURX_FGFX_1900 -i
fi
